  SPEC cert16-tc044-1-firmware-update connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=115
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Received: \[2,.*"UpdateFirmware"/, "UpdateFirmware.req received")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"FirmwareStatusNotification".*"status":"Downloading"/, "Downloading sent")

    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"FirmwareStatusNotification".*"status":"Installing"/, "Installing sent")
    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"FirmwareStatusNotification".*"status":"Installed"/, "Installed sent")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Downloading"/, /"status":"Downloaded"/, "Downloading precedes Downloaded")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Downloaded"/, /"status":"Installing"/, "Downloaded precedes Installing")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Installing"/, /"status":"Installed"/, "Installing precedes Installed")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "FirmwareStatusNotification")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "BootNotification")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "StatusNotification")
  SPEC cert16-tc044-2-firmware-download-failed connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=110

    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Downloading"/, /"status":"DownloadFailed"/, "Downloading precedes DownloadFailed")
    assertNoLineMatches(·, ·, /"status":"Installing"/, "Installing never reached")
    assertNoLineMatches(·, ·, /"status":"Installed"/, "Installed never reached")

    assertLineMatches(·, ·, /Sent: \[2,.*"FirmwareStatusNotification".*"status":"InstallationFailed"/, "InstallationFailed sent")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Downloading"/, /"status":"Downloaded"/, "Downloading precedes Downloaded")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Downloaded"/, /"status":"Installing"/, "Downloaded precedes Installing")
    assertLineOrder(·, ·, /"status":"Installing"/, /"status":"InstallationFailed"/, "Installing precedes InstallationFailed")
    assertNoLineMatches(·, ·, /"status":"Installed"/, "Installed (success terminal state) never reached")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "FirmwareStatusNotification")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "BootNotification")
    assertAllAnswered(·, ·, "StatusNotification")
  SPEC cert16-tc045-1-get-diagnostics connector=1 bootWaitSecs=4 holdSecs=25
